nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 64 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 16 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 37 dB; CMRR at low frequency of at least 40 dB; output swing of at least 1.18 V; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 230 nV/sqrt(Hz); total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1.5 mW; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 75 ns; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 1 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 590 MHz; gain-bandwidth product of at least 770 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 5 mW; output swing of at least 0.68 V; output DC level between 0.315 V and 1.35 V. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a transimpedance amplifier for a photodiode front-end in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 200 fF; photodiode capacitance 500 fF. Requirements: transimpedance gain of at least 112 dB-ohm; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 14 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 53 uW; input-referred noise current density at 1 MHz of at most 310 fA/sqrt(Hz); output DC level between 0.3 V and 1.5 V. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 80 uA (ratio 4) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 2 %; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 190 kohm; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.37 V. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 1.4 %; line regulation of at most 12 mV/V; load-step undershoot of at most 310 mV; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 69 uA; load regulation of at most 18 V/A (= mV/mA); PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 40 dB; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a self-biased voltage reference in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Design a continuous-time voltage comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 50 fF; input common mode 0.9 V, overdrive +-10 mV. Requirements: propagation delay of at most 3.7 ns; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 54 uW; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1; output high level relative to VDD of at least 0.9 x VDD; output low level relative to VDD of at most 0.1 x VDD. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a clocked (dynamic) comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: clock 500 MHz, input difference +-2 mV around 0.9 V. Requirements: clock-to-output delay of at most 640 ps; energy per comparison of at most 210 fJ; correct decisions (1 = yes) of at least 1. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 940 MHz; output swing of at least 1.11 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 990 uW. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 29.9 kHz and 39 kHz; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 19 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 170 uW; passband peaking of at most 0.2 dB. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design a Schmitt trigger in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.

Design an op-amp-based analog computing circuit in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: function: inverting amplifier of vin1 (vin2 unused).
